Acting might be hard than most give it credit for 
🎬 Simon Says (2026)

A group of friends gathers to celebrate a 21st birthday, expecting nothing more than a wild night together. But when an unexpected guest arrives and introduces a game of Simon Says, the celebration quickly spirals into a nightmare. Simple commands become increasingly dangerous, and the group realizes that breaking the rules could have deadly consequences.

With fear rising, friendships are tested as everyone struggles to stay one step ahead of the game. Each new challenge pushes them further into chaos, turning what should have been an unforgettable birthday into a desperate fight to survive until morning.

Mixing slasher horror with twisted humor and plenty of bloody mayhem, Simon Says delivers a deadly spin on the classic childhood game. Watch the full movie now on Tubi.
